name: Horrorbolt Volley on the action bar is saved as Horrorbolt (#5469)
contract: The Horrorbolt Volley buff 255070 is cast on the Cultist after three 255020 stacks from Horrorbolt casts under 704892 (AscensionCultistAbilities.cpp:160-168). AscensionCultist::Refresh, run every 500 ms from cultist_player::OnPlayerUpdate, checks it (AscensionCultist.cpp:249-262, row {800416, 504719, HasAura(255070)}): while the buff is up and Horrorbolt 800416 is known it teaches Horrorbolt Volley 504719 with learnSpell(504719, true), a temporary spell never written to character_spell, and registers it over every known Horrorbolt rank with Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement. The same loop handles Abyssal Ward 804670 -> Black Ward 804711 (706182), Gaze of C'Thun 500110 -> Eldritch Force 680576 (681794) and Twilight Shieldtoss 524876 -> Voidcleave 255282 (255281). Before the fix Player::_SaveActions wrote 504719 for a button holding Horrorbolt Volley, and Player::_LoadActions at the next login runs before Refresh teaches it again, so the button was refused and deleted. The fixture applies 255070 directly instead of building the stacks. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the id _SaveActions writes. A button holding Horrorbolt Volley must be saved as Horrorbolt; a button holding Horrorbolt is saved unchanged.

steps.label: The buff replaces Horrorbolt with Horrorbolt Volley
The Horrorbolt Volley button is saved as Horrorbolt
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
